haberler.baslik: Sri Lanka Records Zero Prosecutions Amid Online Scam Surge
haberler.ozet: As criminal syndicates flee crackdowns in Southeast Asia, Sri Lankan police have detained over 1,000 foreign fraud suspects this year—yet an outdated legal code has left authorities unable to secure a single conviction.
